title: Aggregate Entity Mention Solr Document (v3) - Classic entity types
description: Ordinary aggregate-mention Solr document in the v3 representation. One document aggregates accepted body and title occurrences with the same exact surface and predicted NER type across content items. QID, NIL status and text part do not split its identity; media-source types use their dedicated schema.

id.description: Deterministic aggregate identifier: a1_ followed by unpadded base64url encoding of the first 16 bytes of SHA-256 of compact JSON [surface, predicted type], encoded as UTF-8 without ASCII escaping, extra whitespace or Unicode normalization. Only exact surface and predicted type participate; person-title metadata, body/title text part, entity QID, confidence and counts do not.

surface_s.description: The surface form of the aggregate entity mention. Previous field name: l_s.

mentionSuggest.description: Optional Solr-generated array of surfaces exposed for mention auto-completion. It is absent from submitted disk documents and may be present in indexed readback.

suggest_payload_s.description: Schema importer-built Solr suggester payload containing the document id followed by a literal pipe and ner_predicted_type_s: a1_<digest>|type. The revised importer populates it for every ordinary aggregate document.

ner_predicted_type_s.description: The predicted NER type of the aggregate entity mention. The aggregate identity is the exact surface and this type. Media-source types are validated by the dedicated media-source schema.

occurrence_count_l.description: Integer number of accepted body and title occurrences in this exact surface/type aggregate, including linked and NIL occurrences.

content_item_count_l.description: Integer number of distinct content items containing an accepted body or title occurrence of this aggregate. Count each content item once across both text parts.

linked_occurrence_count_l.description: Integer number of accepted body and title occurrences in this aggregate linked to an entity QID. It may be zero for an all-NIL aggregate.

linked_content_item_count_l.description: Integer number of distinct content items containing at least one linked body or title occurrence in this aggregate. Count each content item once across both parts; zero is permitted for an all-NIL aggregate.

nil_occurrence_count_l.description: Integer number of accepted body and title occurrences in this aggregate without a linked entity QID. It may be zero for an all-linked aggregate.

scopes_ss.description: Optional presence scopes for this aggregate: the union of body/title text parts containing its accepted occurrences, whether linked or NIL. Emit body before title when both are present. Scopes do not split aggregate identity or counts; occurrence counts combine both parts and distinct-content-item counts use their union.
